description: Runtime database users, provisioned least-privileged per service.
autoMigrateNote: Doppler's value. deploy/k8s/*.yaml pins DB_AUTO_MIGRATE as a pod env var, which outranks this, so production may differ.
rotateBody: Provisions a fresh MySQL user for {schema} and writes it to Doppler ({project}/{config}). The Doppler operator then restarts {service}, and only {service}. The old user stays until you revoke it.
setBody: Provisions the named MySQL user with data-only grants on {schema} and writes it to Doppler with auto-migrate on. The Doppler operator then restarts {service}, and only {service}.
revokeBody: Drops the MySQL user and every grant it holds. Revoke only retired users: {service} crashes if you drop the one currently in Doppler.
genNote: Generated with your browser's CSPRNG. Nothing here is sent to any server.
